description: Inject Bedrock-accurate HTTP 503, 429, or 529 responses at a temporary gateway provider/upstream proxy running on ECS/Fargate or an equivalent runtime, controlled through SSM Automation. The proxy passes non-faulted requests to real Bedrock.

injectBedrockGatewayFault.description: Toggle the injector into fault mode for a bounded window, with guaranteed rollback

parameters.documentArn: arn:aws:ssm:<YOUR REGION>:<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:document/<YOUR AUTOMATION DOCUMENT NAME>
parameters.documentParameters: {"GatewayType": "<YOUR GATEWAY TYPE>", "InjectorId": "<YOUR INJECTOR ID>", "FaultType": "503", "FaultRate": "0.5", "LatencyMs": "0", "Rules": "", "DurationSeconds": "900", "AutomationAssumeRole": "arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR SSM AUTOMATION IAM ROLE NAME>"}

stopConditions.value: arn:aws:cloudwatch:<YOUR REGION>:<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:alarm:<YOUR APPLICATION ERROR RATE ALARM NAME>

roleArn: arn:aws:iam::<YOUR AWS ACCOUNT>:role/<YOUR FIS IAM ROLE NAME>
